event_fact_summary: Nucor selected West Virginia for a new approximately $2.7 billion sheet mill with planned annual capacity of three million tons.
materiality_reason: A large greenfield capacity commitment changed future sheet-steel capacity, geographic reach and capital-allocation requirements.

event_fact_summary: Steel Dynamics authorized an estimated $2.2 billion recycled-aluminum flat rolled mill and two slab centers totaling 650,000 tonnes of rolling capacity.
materiality_reason: The project represented entry into an adjacent aluminum market with large new capacity and stated through-cycle EBITDA implications.

event_fact_summary: Constellation and Meta signed a 20-year PPA for the 1,121 MW Clinton Clean Energy Center and planned 30 MW of uprates.
materiality_reason: A long-duration hyperscaler power contract materially extended asset economics and supported continued operation and capacity expansion.

event_fact_summary: Micron announced a preliminary agreement for $6.1 billion of CHIPS Act grants supporting planned leading-edge memory manufacturing in Idaho and New York and approximately $50 billion of gross U.S. capex through 2030.
materiality_reason: Government funding materially affected the financing and feasibility of a multi-fab domestic memory-capacity expansion.

event_fact_summary: Digital Realty and Blackstone announced a joint venture to develop four hyperscale campuses with approximately $7 billion of estimated development cost and about 500 MW of potential IT load.
materiality_reason: The partnership changed the funding structure and prospective capacity pipeline for a capital-intensive data-center REIT.

event_fact_summary: Equinix agreed to form a greater-than-$15 billion JV with GIC and CPP Investments intended to add more than 1.5 GW of U.S. xScale hyperscale capacity.
materiality_reason: The JV materially expanded access to external capital and prospective AI/cloud data-center capacity.

event_fact_summary: GM announced more than $7 billion of Michigan manufacturing investment covering EV assembly and battery-cell capacity, the largest single investment announcement in company history at that time.
materiality_reason: The commitment materially changed planned North American EV and battery production capacity and capital deployment.

event_fact_summary: Advance Auto Parts reported Q1 results below expectations, materially reduced full-year sales, margin and EPS guidance, and cut its quarterly dividend.
materiality_reason: The release simultaneously reset operating profitability, forward earnings and capital-return expectations.

event_fact_summary: Lowe's reported weaker discretionary demand and reduced full-year sales, comparable-sales, margin and EPS guidance.
materiality_reason: A broad forward-demand and profitability reset changed the expected earnings path for a large home-improvement retailer.

event_fact_summary: Ulta reported Q1 fiscal 2024 results and lowered full-year sales, comparable-sales, operating-margin and EPS guidance.
materiality_reason: The release reset demand and margin expectations in a previously high-growth specialty retail category.

event_fact_summary: Gilead announced that Phase 3 EVOKE-01 evaluating Trodelvy in previously treated metastatic NSCLC did not meet its primary overall-survival endpoint, while noting a numerical OS improvement in a prespecified subgroup and no new safety signal.
materiality_reason: A pivotal negative/mixed oncology readout directly altered the evidence base for a material expansion indication and required interpretation beyond a binary headline.

event_fact_summary: Salesforce disclosed a restructuring plan including an approximately 10% workforce reduction, real-estate actions and expected restructuring charges.
materiality_reason: The program represented a company-wide cost-structure and operating-margin intervention rather than an ordinary personnel change.

event_fact_summary: Meta disclosed plans to reduce headcount by about 13% or more than 11,000 employees, extend its hiring freeze, reduce spending and lower its 2023 total-expense outlook.
materiality_reason: The announcement materially changed the company's cost base, hiring trajectory and capital-efficiency framework.

event_fact_summary: Warner Bros. Discovery announced a new structure centered on Global Linear Networks and Streaming & Studios to increase strategic flexibility and potential value-creation optionality.
materiality_reason: The reorganization changed the corporate perimeter and strategic options for businesses with materially different growth, cash-flow and leverage profiles.

event_fact_summary: Intel announced CEO Pat Gelsinger's retirement, interim co-CEOs, a new CEO of Intel Products and a board-led search for a permanent successor while maintaining the foundry leadership structure.
materiality_reason: Leadership transition at a company undergoing a capital-intensive manufacturing and foundry transformation materially changed execution and governance expectations.
